study: Three fixed day-trading candidates, continuation of the first stock screen
selection: Same four instruments as the first screen. No parameter search; retain every result. These data were previously examined with other rules, so this entire comparison is exploratory.
windows: Same fixed 70/30 chronological split as prior study; 240-bar indicator warmup plus 14 complete prior sessions for volume baselines. Independent fresh balances for earlier and later tests. Repeat later at 1.5x costs; entry sets may differ.
data: Reuse the exact frozen Yahoo regular-session 5m snapshots from the first study. Split-adjusted OHLC; no interpolated bars, cash dividends excluded. No point-in-time news filter or historical stock-universe ranking.
research_gate: All three remain research-only regardless of results. A 12-session later sample cannot establish a reliable edge. Next confirmation requires at least 12-24 months of intraday data spanning varied conditions and then an untouched forward-paper period.
no_optimization: Do not tune rules, cut losing symbols, or modify cost assumptions in response to these returns. Software correctness fixes require rerunning all cases and recording the reason.
